notes.title: Major Update of Marmargee Fighter Girl vs. Zombies & Monsters now available!
notes.content:
Weekly Leaderboards integrated per difficulty level!
Become and stay the leader and share screenshots with your friends...
Checkpoint system for every 25 enemies killed!
Balanced movement mechanics & jumping speed!
Better integration with Steam Stats & Achievements!
Enhanced graphics and lighting effects!
In-game screen resolution selector added.

notes.title: Update 27th February 2024 Steam Achievements
notes.content:
This desktop version of Marmargee Fighter Girl vs. Zombies & Monsters has been updated to be more integrated with Steam: it will require the player to be logged into Steam to use Steam Achievements & Stats. We hope you enjoy this updated version. 
The MAR2XGAMES team.
